guidelines.description: All percentage discounts (e.g., 50% OFF, 70% OFF) must explicitly state product inclusions, minimum spends, or exclusions in both image copy and accompanying caption.
guidelines.required_disclaimer_text: *Terms apply. See full details at brandguard.com/terms

guidelines.description: Promotional percentages, prices, warranty durations, and coupon codes must match exactly between the visual graphic and caption text.
Audio soundbars and home speakers are limited strictly to the 1-Year Manufacturer Warranty unless a certified extended plan is explicitly sold.
Headlines, sub-copy, and CTAs must be free of typographical and spelling mistakes before public release.
Flash sale end dates in graphic footers must synchronize with copy deadlines. No retroactive date extensions permitted.
Official logos must maintain minimum 16px clear space and may not be distorted, recolored off-palette, or cropped.
Electronic charging power claims (e.g., GaN 65W vs 100W) must match product chassis labels and verified laboratory spec sheets.
Eco-friendly and sustainability claims require accredited certification reference (e.g., B-Corp, ASTM standard retention note).
guidelines.required_disclaimer_text: Tested according to ASTM international thermal standards.

guidelines.description: Phrases like "100% Guaranteed Best in the World" or "Zero Competitor Equal" require third-party verification benchmarks.
Third-party endorsement seals (such as "Dermatologist Approved", medical crosses, or certification stamps) are prohibited unless certified and registered in the Brand Assets Registry.

guidelines.rule_title: Substantiation Required for Clinical & Anti-Aging Claims
guidelines.description: Health, cosmetic, and anti-aging claims (such as "removes wrinkles in 7 days" or "guarantees younger skin") require approved clinical trial evidence in the knowledge base. In absence of evidence, claim is unsupported.
